title: Operations workspace
subtitle: Manage the fictional catalogue and physical stock. Changes stay in this browser.
adminOnly: Switch to Admin preview to edit catalogue data. Display modes are not authentication.
name: Name
matrixNote: New colour × size combinations start with zero stock. Existing SKU identities and variants are retained. Archive individual variants below; removing a colour from this form does not delete its history.
archiveNote: The record and its stock remain in history. Active picks must be resolved before archiving.
locationNote: Boxes with stock or active picks cannot be renamed, moved or disabled. Rack and shelf names group boxes; edit empty boxes individually.
stockNote: Counts replace on-hand and non-sellable quantities. Transfers preserve total stock. Damage keeps physical units on hand but removes them from sellable stock.
stockConfirmBody: This updates the selected SKU and records a movement. Check the source, quantity and reason before continuing.
imagePolicy: JPEG, PNG or WebP only. Uploads are resized to 1000 px and compressed to JPEG; up to 12 images and 2.5 MB of encoded image data per demo. Images persist in this browser and are included in saved data. Reset removes uploads.
label: Image description
imageRemoveBody: This removes this browser’s saved copy of the image.
returnBody: Returned units will enter the chosen box. Refunds use the original paid amount, including allocated discounts and tax. No real payment is sent.
replacementNote: A return is refunded in full first. A linked replacement is a separate sale at its current price. No hidden netting or real money transfer.
posNote: Confirm the units are physically retrieved from this box. This creates a saved bill; stock decreases only when the bill is completed.
vocabNote: Renames update all designs, including archived records. Used values cannot be removed.
invalidImage: Image could not be processed. Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP under 10 MB.
unsavedHint: Unsaved design edits. Save before leaving.
intakeNote: Nothing changes until confirmation. Existing quantities are added as restock; new SKUs receive opening stock. Photos are optional. All records are fictional demo data.
invalidMatrix: Enter whole quantities from 0 to 100000 and an active destination for each nonzero row.
matrixInstructions: Enter units to receive for each colour and size. Zero skips stock. Split a SKU across more boxes using Add box row.
reviewTotals: {variants} colour/size combinations · {units} units to receive · {photos} photos
fourPhotos: Choose up to four photos per batch.
photoDrop: Drop photos here or browse — up to 4 images, JPEG / PNG / WebP, 10 MB each.
saveBeforeAdd: Save your bill edits before adding more items.
chooseSkuSource: Enter an exact SKU to see available boxes
emptyBox: This box is empty. Its location is retained for future stock.
